name: ste-rewrite
description: Rewrites requirement or documentation text in plain, simple English in the style of Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100). Use when asked to simplify, shorten, clarify, or make text easier to read for non-native readers.
---
# Simplified Technical English rewrite

## Rules
1. One idea per sentence. Maximum 20 words per sentence. Maximum 6 sentences per paragraph.
2. Use the active voice. Say who does what. "The system sends a message", not "A message is sent".
3. Use the present tense for facts and rules.
4. Use one word for one thing. Take the term from the glossary if there is one.
5. Use simple words. Examples: "utilize" -> "use", "prior to" -> "before", "in the event that" -> "if".
6. In procedures, write one instruction per sentence. Start with the verb. "Enter the amount."
7. Do not remove information. Do not add information.
8. Keep IDs, numbers, units, and product names exactly as they are.

## Output
1. The rewritten text.
2. A short list "Changed:" with the hard words you replaced.
